## Pathway to Developing Mathematical Thinking (US Curriculum)
Welcome, students! The Common Core Mathematics curriculum is widely adopted in US international schools, focusing on critical thinking, real-world problem-solving, and deep understanding of mathematical concepts from algebra to geometry. 

K-Education Hub provides comprehensive study materials, core notes, and practice exercises aligned with the five primary high school pathways: **Math Grade 6-8**, **Algebra 1**, **Geometry**, **Algebra 2**, and **Pre-Calculus**. Select your module below to begin.
:::

## Choose Your Study Pathway

Select your specific course to access practice worksheets, core summaries, and key formulas:

::: {.program-grid}

::: {.program-card}
### Math Grade 6-8
**US Middle School Mathematics Curriculum**

- Focus: Mental math strategies, logical reasoning, advanced arithmetic, introduction to algebra, and basic spatial geometry.
- Practice high-speed problem-solving skills and non-calculator mathematics.
- [Explore Math Grade 6-8 Resources &rarr;](math-grade-6-8.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Algebra 1
**High School Algebra 1**

- Focus: Linear equations and inequalities, systems of equations, quadratic functions and graphs, polynomials, and basic exponents.
- Establishes a fundamental algebraic foundation crucial for high school success.
- [Explore Algebra 1 Resources &rarr;](algebra1.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Geometry
**High School Geometry**

- Focus: Congruence and similarity proofs, right triangle trigonometry, coordinate geometry, circles, and 2D/3D shape volumes.
- Enhances spatial reasoning and logical geometric proof construction.
- [Explore Geometry Resources &rarr;](geometry.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Algebra 2
**High School Algebra 2**

- Focus: Exponential and logarithmic functions, complex numbers, non-linear equations, basic matrices, probability, and advanced trig.
- [Explore Algebra 2 Resources &rarr;](algebra2.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Pre-Calculus
**High School Pre-Calculus**

- Focus: Complex trigonometric functions, limits, sequences and series, vectors, and foundations for AP Calculus.
- [Explore Pre-Calculus Resources &rarr;](pre-calculus.qmd)
:::

:::
